sources.note: Dataset covers Achang, Xiandao, Lashi, Old Burmese, Rangoon, Maru, Atsi, Bola, Proto-Burmish; no Chashan variety.

sources.citation: Tibeto-Burman linguistics list, 2016-09, 'a few Chinese publications on Burmish languages' (N. Hill / H. Sawada)
sources.note: Hill asks for the 2010 Chashan book; Sawada offers scans of Leqiyu yanjiu 2007, Langsu yu yanjiu 2005, Zaiwa 1984 only — the Chashan book is not among them.
Source listed as Dai (2010) 'Pianma Chashan ren ji qi yuyan'; no prosody/stress features displayed.
No descriptive references at all; only a classification comment citing Dai 2010: 118. Placed under Burmish > Northern > Maru > Leqi > Chashan.

sources.citation: 《民族语文》目录索引（1979年至2023年第2期）, CASS Institute of Ethnology
sources.note: a full-text search for stress/accent the full index: no article on 茶山语/片马 through 2023 no.2; 李春风's Minzu Yuwen articles (2011-2020) are all on Lahu.

sources.citation: 戴庆厦、余金枝、余成林、林新宇、范丽君. [2010]. 片马茶山人和谐的多语生活 [The harmonious multilingual life of the Chashan people of Pianma]. China-Europa Forum working paper, 13 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic study of multilingualism (78 speakers surveyed in 古浪/岗房/下片马). Only phonological remark (p.2): 勒期语有长短元音的对立，茶山语没有; 勒期语的双唇颚化音茶山语大多消失. No mention of 声调/重音/音节.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Chashan language'; Wikipedia (zh) '茶山语'; Zhihu 缅彝语群各语言简介(2)：缅语支 (Chashan section)
sources.note: Nothing on stress or tones beyond the autonym transcription ŋɔ³¹tʃʰaŋ⁵⁵; cite only Dai 2010 and the China-Europa Forum paper. The Zhihu '弱化音节的轻声调' sentence belongs to the Zaiwa section, not Chashan.

sources.citation: 戴庆厦. 2025. 序《景颇族·怒江州片马茶山语参考语法》, in 戴庆厦, 语言学著作序文集·第2辑. 北京: 中央民族大学出版社. ISBN 9787566025135.

sources.note: Dai's preface to Li 2023 may summarise the grammar's phonological findings (tone inventory, weak syllables); listed in the frelax/schoolbus catalogue of the volume.

sources.citation: 李春风. 2023. 景颇族·怒江州片马茶山语参考语法. 广州: 暨南大学出版社. ISBN 9787566834560.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Only reference grammar of Chashan; Chapter 2 语音系统 has sections 声调 (tones) and 弱化音节 (weakened syllables) and 音节结构类型 — the place where a statement on stress/prominence (or its absence in a tone language) would sit. Based on 2016-2020 fieldwork; won the Jinan University Zhan Bohui Linguistics Award (2025).

sources.citation: Sawada, Hideo. 2017. Two undescribed dialects of Northern Burmish sub-branch: Gyannoʔ and Thoʔlhang. Paper at ICSTLL 50, Beijing.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Describes Burma-side Northern Burmish varieties near Lashi; worth checking whether either corresponds to the Kachin-State Chashan (Echang) communities the Chinese sources mention, and whether Sawada gives a prosodic statement. Relevance unverified.

sources.citation: 戴庆厦 主编 (余金枝, 余成林 et al.). 2010. 片马茶山人及其语言. 北京: 商务印书馆. 228 pp. ISBN 9787100069069.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: print only (no digital copy found when the work was looked up)
sources.note: First and, until 2023, only description of Chashan (language-use survey plus a grammatical sketch with phonology; Glottolog cites p.118). Dai's school typically states whether a language has 区别意义的重音; would supersede or corroborate Li 2023 for the 2009 generation of speakers.

sources.citation: 李春风. 2023. 景颇族·怒江州片马茶山语参考语法 [A reference grammar of Chashan of Pianma, Nujiang Prefecture (Jingpo nationality)]. 广州: 暨南大学出版社 (国家社会科学基金项目文库·语言学研究). ISBN 9787566834560.
sources.tag: not read: abstract or record only
sources.note: Text not accessible (WeRead paywalled; Google Books ids jND40AEACAAJ/ldIS0AEACAAJ no preview). WeRead TOC seen: 第二章 语音系统 — 第一节 声母, 第二节 韵母, 第三节 声调, 第四节 弱化音节, 第五节 音节结构类型. Blurb: fieldwork 2016-2020, ~100 speakers, 20万字 IPA corpus; 'the phonology, vocabulary and grammar' described systematically. The 弱化音节 section is the likely home of any stress/prominence statement.

sources.citation: 戴庆厦 主编 (余金枝, 余成林 et al.). 2010. 片马茶山人及其语言 [The Chashan people of Pianma and their language]. 北京: 商务印书馆. 228 pp. ISBN 9787100069069.
